page.layout: One page of text, title block at top, verse epigram in the centre, a decorative ornament below, signature mark at the bottom right; no margin notes.

main_text.head: DE IVSTI LIPSI LIBRIS DE CRVCE, MICHAELIS VANDER-HAGEN ANTVERPIENSIS Ad Lectorem Epigramma.
main_text.p: SI te prisca iuuant: hoc, docti, DE CRVCE, LIPSI, Ingentis plenum, volue, laboris opus. Supplicium Crucis ille vetus describit ad vnguem, Quale fuit, nostram SALVIFICAMQVE CRVCEM: In qua hominum lapsus, scelerumque Piator, atrocem Mortem, insons, multo sanguine passus erat. Vnde noua extinctis lux extitit, vnde sepultis Vita oriens, rutilam sustulit alta facem. Vnde redemptio & alma reconciliatio manant: Vnde perennantis flumina pacis eunt. Ista vetustatis referat penetralia, Lector, Vtere eo, & quantus, disce, vir ille fiet.

page.notes: Initial S is a large decorative letter joined to "I te" as printed. Scan is faintly blurred; the line "Ingentis plenum, volue, laboris opus" is read with some uncertainty ("volue" may be "volue" or "volve"). Pale stamp-like marks at lower left are not transcribed.
